stages.headline: The segment joining the midpoints of two sides of a triangle is a midline.
stages.headlineEnglish: The segment joining the midpoints of two sides of a triangle is a midline.

stages.headline: Theorem: a midline is parallel to the third side and equal to half of it.
stages.headlineEnglish: Theorem: a midline is parallel to the third side and equal to half of it.

stages.headline: Example: a triangle with sides 6, 8, 10; the triangle of its midlines has sides 3, 4, 5.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: a triangle with sides 6, 8, 10; the triangle of its midlines has sides 3, 4, 5.
